raw_segments.text: What is there disgraceful to your thinking, in your having set aside half of the three
thousand you had discreditably, if you prefer, disgracefully, appropriated?
Your taking the three thousand is more important than what you did with it.
And by the way, why did you do that?
Why did you set apart that half?
For what object did you do it?
Can you explain that to us?
